reviews.title: Great kit for Steam deck !!
reviews.comment:
This steam deck hard drive adapter was a great set that included everything that you need to swap parts and maintenance your Steam Deck.  The item matched the description as described. I don't know that someone who is completely ignorant to it, could swap it without watching YouTube videos, but it was surprisingly easy for someone who has even a basic knowledge of the steam deck parts and build.
Overall I think the set is complete and well made.  It included all the tools you will need and was pretty easy to do.  I think this kit is a great option and I am glad we ordered it.
reviews.author: Mrs. Garcia

reviews.title: Great for other tinker projects
reviews.comment:
This adapter is a total win for anyone looking to bypass the "2230 tax" and drop a full-sized drive into their handheld. The build quality is surprisingly robust; the PCB feels solid, and the gold-plated contacts ensure a stable connection without any noticeable hits to data transfer speeds.
While it’s marketed specifically for the Steam Deck LCD, the design is versatile enough that I’ve already started eyeing it for a few other tinker projects. If you have a tight space that usually only fits a 2230 but you have just enough lateral room to reroute, this is a fantastic way to get a high-capacity 2280 NVMe drive running where it shouldn’t.
Pros:
Great quality circuit board and clean traces.
Includes all the necessary bits (screwdriver, screws, and thermal pad).
Opens up much cheaper high-capacity storage options.
If you’re comfortable opening up your hardware, this is a must-have for your toolkit.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Everything You Need for Steam Deck Tinkering
reviews.comment:
I picked this up to do some work on my Steam Deck, and I’m really satisfied with it. It came with all the right pieces needed to get started, which was my main concern going in. Everything included matched the listing and worked exactly as expected.
The flex cable itself is well-made and fit properly without any issues during installation. It lined up correctly with the connectors! I also liked that it came with extra tools and accessories, like the small screwdriver and the plastic pry tools. The screwdriver is solid enough to get the job done, and the pry tools helped avoid damaging anything while opening up the device. Having everything in one kit made the process a lot more convenient instead of needing to hunt down separate tools.
This is definitely more of a tinkering/DIY product, so you should have at least some comfort working with electronics, but if you do, this makes the job straightforward.
If you’re planning to repair or modify your Steam Deck LCD, this is a solid option that gives you the parts and tools in one package.
reviews.author: Lucia

reviews.title: simple nvme adapter for larger steam deck upgrades
reviews.comment:
This is a straightforward NVMe adapter that reroutes the SSD connection in the Steam Deck LCD to allow for larger drives, including full-length 2280 (and similar) NVMe SSDs. Installation is simple, and it effectively relocates the drive across the battery area, opening up a lot more flexibility compared to being limited to 2230 drives.
In use, it doesn’t appear to introduce any performance issues. The traces are clean and evenly extended, so speeds remain consistent with what you’d expect from the drive itself. That makes it a practical solution rather than just a novelty mod.
The biggest advantage here is cost and capacity. Instead of paying a premium for high-capacity 2230 drives, you can use more common and often cheaper larger SSDs, making multi-terabyte upgrades far more accessible.
Overall, it’s a simple but effective adapter that does exactly what it promises and makes expanding storage on the Steam Deck much more flexible.
